name: Glassline Safehouse
description: A shielded courier cellar serving as home, workshop, and refuge.

actions.label: Meet Mira in the signal room
actions.description: Begin the Glassline investigation.

actions.label: Search the old courier cache
actions.description: Inspect a forgotten floor compartment.

outcome.title: Courier Cache
outcome.resultText: One stabilized ether vial and a strip of resonant scrap survived the damp.

outcome.title: Rested
outcome.resultText: The safehouse dampeners grant six quiet hours.

actions.label: Rest by the receiver
actions.description: Treat the worst injuries without closing Rhea’s channel.

outcome.title: A Short Rest
outcome.resultText: Four hours pass. Rhea does not arrive.

actions.label: Check every channel
actions.description: Search courier relays and emergency frequencies for Rhea.

outcome.title: No Message
outcome.resultText: No courier signature. No emergency burst. The connection attempt fails.

actions.label: Listen to the resonance
actions.description: Focus on what followed you out of Ares.

actions.label: Wait until morning
actions.description: Leave the receiver open and watch the door.

name: Prism Night Market
description: A covered market of rain curtains, counterfeit credentials, and whispered faction business.

actions.label: Trade with Nix Vale
actions.description: Buy, sell, and inspect faction-sensitive prices.

outcome.title: Dead-Air Ledger
outcome.resultText: Nix wants a clean capture of OmniCorp’s encrypted burst.

passOutcome.title: Burst Captured
passOutcome.resultText: Nix pays promptly and slides an access shard across the counter.

failOutcome.title: Signal Lost
failOutcome.resultText: The corporate burst dissolves into static.

outcome.title: Names Returned
outcome.resultText: People repeat recovered names aloud. Nix gives you a respectful nod.

outcome.title: Profitable Silence
outcome.resultText: The archive is already being partitioned for buyers.

name: Sable Street Clinic
description: A failing community clinic lit by one stubborn blue surgical lamp.

actions.label: Ask Sable about the closed zone

outcome.title: Cold Cradle Restored
outcome.resultText: The recovery cradle hums back to life. Sable promises to help the safehouse after the annex job.

name: Abandoned Glassline Station
description: Platform Zero lies behind a maintenance shutter omitted from public maps.

outcome.title: Sealed Medical Crate
outcome.resultText: You recover sterile coolant and a resonant conductor strip.

name: Glassline Security Annex
description: A sealed corporate archive embedded in black reflective glass.

outcome.title: Quiet Glass
outcome.resultText: The panes now reflect ordinary faces instead of stolen memories.

name: Service Gate 6
description: A staff door sits below the loading decks, its badge reader blinking through rain and camera glare.

actions.label: Loop the badge reader
actions.description: Spoof a maintenance cycle before the camera turns.

check.passText: The reader accepts a clean maintenance loop.
check.partialText: The loop holds, but the controller records an anomaly.
check.failText: The reader rejects the splice and marks the port.

actions.label: Cross the service threshold
actions.description: Confirm the route with Rhea and Dax, then enter.

name: Cold-Storage Warehouse
description: Freight lifters sleep between black storage aisles. Somewhere overhead, an inspection drone rolls along its rail.

actions.label: Sweep the staff lockers
actions.description: Take only what the team can carry quietly.

outcome.title: Locker Cache
outcome.resultText: You recover 65 credits, a trauma patch, and a compact ether baton.

actions.label: Check the team
actions.description: Pause beneath the lifter noise before moving deeper.

name: Maintenance Control
description: A glass control booth overlooks the conveyors. Its terminal still trusts the night-shift network.

actions.label: Breach the shift network
actions.description: Pull selected payloads before the local trace closes.

actions.label: Search the abandoned desk
actions.description: Check the night supervisor’s station for a physical route note.

outcome.title: Shift Desk
outcome.resultText: The useful files were purged, but the terminal remains connected.

name: Freight Lock 3
description: A pressure gate divides the public logistics ring from the classified levels below.

actions.label: Mark the blind approach
actions.description: Use the stolen route map to avoid the checkpoint’s main firing line.

outcome.title: Route Prepared
outcome.resultText: The team marks a maintenance channel beneath the main checkpoint.

actions.label: Cycle Freight Lock 3
actions.description: Commit the team to the classified levels below.

name: Decontamination Hall C
description: Cleansing mist drifts over dead guards and broken drones. The guards’ armor is almost untouched.

actions.label: Examine the casualties
actions.description: Find what killed the guards without damaging their armor.

actions.label: Search the security detail
actions.description: Recover field supplies without disturbing the scene further.

outcome.title: Security Supplies
outcome.resultText: You recover 40 credits, ammunition cells, and one trauma patch.

name: Palimpsest Research Annex
description: Cracked observation glass surrounds terminals labelled for cognitive-interface trials.

actions.label: Reconstruct Project Palimpsest
actions.description: Recover the surviving fragments of Ares’s contact trials.

actions.label: Open the neural case
actions.description: Bypass the purge seal around an intact research prototype.

check.passText: The case opens around an intact cognitive filter.
check.partialText: The filter is ruined, but useful control components remain.
check.failText: The biometric seal destroys its own control board.

name: Vault Security Nexus
description: The last active command station controls response shutters, the armory, and Central Vault access.

actions.label: Blind the response grid
actions.description: Suppress automated security before opening the vault route.

check.passText: The response grid enters maintenance lockout.
check.failText: The Nexus rejects the override and hardens its remaining channels.

actions.label: Use the keycard on the armory
actions.description: Open the emergency stock with the checkpoint credential.

outcome.title: Emergency Armory
outcome.resultText: The keycard releases medical patches and ammunition cells.

actions.label: Force the armory lock
actions.description: Break the warped secondary latch without a valid credential.

check.passText: The armory yields medical patches and ammunition cells.
check.failText: The warped lock refuses to cycle.

actions.label: Regroup at the vault seal
actions.description: Give Rhea and Dax one last chance to call the operation.

name: Central Containment Vault
description: Magnetic frames surround something built like a machine and felt like a presence.

actions.label: Open containment access
actions.description: Enter the chamber together. There is no clean reading from inside.
